meta.source: brand/opendesigner (OpenDesigner engine sketch, Hanken Grotesk, brand #2338FF, warmth 30) plus a brand layer for display sizes

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is the default; Dark for night posts and code; Cobalt for one bold brand moment per set.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and cards that must separate from surface (specimens inside a post).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, the area behind a specimen.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus-adjacent edges; at least 3:1 on surface in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (ledes, captions) on surface and surface-raised; at least 4.5:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand cobalt: primary buttons, the highlight box, the circle in the mark. On Cobalt the accent turns white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent words set as text, on surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (button labels, the phrase inside the highlight box).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds behind accent-text: selected rows, chips.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Fill box behind the one highlighted phrase in a headline. Once per screen.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighted phrase sitting on the highlight box.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the surface color; 3:1 against every surface.

families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statement on a web page; one per page. Web H1 when the page has a hero.
styles.sample: Design systems, one decision at a time.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title (H1) when there is no hero; section openers on long marketing pages.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section title (H3), feature names in a row of three.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Overlines and the smallest heading (H6); same size as body, set apart by weight.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Ledes under a page or section title; at most 3 lines.
styles.sample: Answer five plain questions. Get a complete, checked design system as files.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. Measure 60 to 70 characters.
styles.sample: Every value comes from a formula, and every color pair is checked in both themes.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, legal lines. The smallest size; never for anything a reader must act on.
styles.sample: Free and open source · MIT licence

styles.name: social-statement
styles.usage: The one statement on a 1600 x 900 post; at most two lines.

styles.name: social-headline
styles.usage: Headline on a 1600 x 900 post or a 1080 x 1350 slide.

styles.name: social-subhead
styles.usage: Second level on a post; numbers in a specimen.

styles.name: social-body
styles.usage: Body on a post: the smallest size a reader must read on a phone (a 1600 px post shows at about a quarter size).
styles.sample: Colors, type and spacing that work together.

styles.name: social-label
styles.usage: Labels inside specimens and the page counter; never carries meaning alone.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file names and token names. Code only, never decoration.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inside chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between a headline and what follows on a post.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Section padding on the web; post margin at 1080 wide.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Section gaps; post margin at 1600 wide.

tokens.name: radius-detail
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, the highlight box corner.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-container
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large specimens on posts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and the circle in the mark.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Specimen panels on posts. Nothing else is raised.
